description: The plot illustrates how accuracy at rank 1 (Accuracy@1) varies with the number of child nodes (tree width), showing two line series across the same x-values. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)” on a linear scale with tick marks at 1, 3, 5, and 7 (range 1–7, no units shown). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly 15% to 38%, with labeled ticks at 15, 20, 25, 30, and 35. One series is a darker blue solid line with circular markers (labeled “GPT-4o” in the legend), with annotated values increasing from 24.4 at x=1 to 28.9 at x=3, rising to 34.4 at x=5, then decreasing to 31.1 at x=7. The second series is a lighter blue solid line with “x” markers (legend text not visible in the cropped image), with annotated values starting at 26.7 at x=1, rising to 27.8 at x=3, then declining to 24.4 at x=5 and further to 20.0 at x=7.
